# Reduced official-source fixtures

These are minimal structural fixtures, not archived raw pages.

- `jleague_regulation.html` retains the score-board structure observed at the
  official 2018 League Cup match route
  `https://data.j-league.or.jp/SFMS02/?match_card_id=21051`.
- `jleague_extra_pk.html` retains the explicit regulation, extra-time and PK
  separation observed at the official 2024 League Cup final route
  `https://data.j-league.or.jp/SFMS02/?match_card_id=31274`.

Names are shortened deliberately. Tests supply exact expected strings; the
fixtures must never be represented as raw-source archives or full match data.
